data.long_meaning: The name Hilleary is recorded with the meaning “God's sunray”. Hilleary is a Biblical name meaning “God's sunray”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
